result.summary: The UI displays minor layout inconsistencies and placeholder content that affects visual polish.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' section are truncated and cut off.
issues.suggestion: Implement flexible text wrapping or dynamic font sizing for longer titles.

issues.description: Generic vector illustrations are used instead of actual food photography.
issues.suggestion: Update assets to include high-quality, real-world images of the food items.

issues.description: The bottom-most card is partially obscured by the navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Adjust vertical spacing and scroll padding to ensure card details are visible.
